source_records.source_detail_constraints: Exact2:1 source128x64 atlas, no affine warp. Top-left plain gray framed plate preserves original long horizontal shaded grooves/dark stripes, their nonuniform phase around native y5,y9,y14 (last is border band), no new equally spaced ribs or extra stripes. Top-right TWO dark loop/aperture shapes retain exact angular stepped silhouettes and source shade, not metal rivets or round drilled screw heads. Middle band contains exactly FIVE dark rectangular slots, source native near x29..33, x42..47, x56..61, x69..75, x82..87, source y27..31. CRITICAL: FIRST LEFT slot stays uniformly dark with NO pale central line/dot; the following FOUR each keep ONE tiny original pale horizontal center line, same UV centers/length/phase. Never add sixth slot, pale center in first, new perforation rings or vent lips. Tall right warmbrown strip and one lower horizontal warmbrown patch preserve source plain understated grain and shadow, no carved groove/knots/curls. Lower gray receiver pieces retain source plain outlined rectangle at left, one small dark leftmark nativearound(3,46), original narrow gray strip near right and exact bottom fields/edge clipping. Existing blackUV gap fields remain RGBblack even at sourceApositive.
